marvel_s_blade_developer_attracts_a_surp.summary: Arkane Studios’ Lyon studio faces a reported bidding war that could keep it alive and allow the upcoming Marvel’s Blade game to continue development.
highlights: Ubisoft is the only named bidder interested in acquiring Arkane Lyon, with at least two other unnamed parties also in the mix
French labor laws require Microsoft to find a buyer for the studio, extending the consultation deadline past the original November 13 date
If the studio is sold, the Blade game—expected to release in the next year or two—could see a PlayStation 5 version instead of being Xbox‑exclusive
marvel_s_blade_developer_attracts_a_surp.why_it_matters: Saving Arkane Lyon would preserve a renowned immersive‑sim developer and keep Marvel’s Blade on track, potentially expanding its platform reach.

dc_darkseid_archenemy_change.headline: DC All-In Saga: Darkseid vs. The World #1
dc_darkseid_archenemy_change.summary: The new issue reveals Darkseid naming Superman as his opposite number, shifting his traditional rivalry with Orion.
highlights: Darkseid vs. The World #1 is part of the ongoing DC All-In Saga and reintroduces Darkseid after his defeat in the 2025 DC K.O. storyline
The issue changes Darkseid’s classic prophecy by declaring Superman, not Orion, as his ultimate opposite
Darkseid’s new goal is the Omega Singularity, an evolution of his quest for the Anti‑Life Equation
dc_darkseid_archenemy_change.why_it_matters: Altering Darkseid’s primary nemesis reshapes a core mythos created by Jack Kirby, impacting future New Gods narratives

event_horizon_director_officially_cosmic.headline: Nether Station & Nether Vortex Film Adaptations
highlights: Anderson is attached as director and producer for the adaptations
Screenplays are being written by Jonathan Wakeham
Weird Tales president John Harlacher and VP of film Tony Eldridge are also producing
The novels follow neurodivergent scientist Cammie Skoura on a deep‑space expedition
event_horizon_director_officially_cosmic.why_it_matters: The partnership reunites Anderson with the cosmic‑horror inspiration that shaped the source material, promising a high‑profile space horror film.

marvel_zodiac_series_details.headline: Zodiac
marvel_zodiac_series_details.summary: Marvel Television announced the new spy‑thriller series Zodiac, slated to premiere on Disney+ in 2028.
highlights: Announced at New York Comic Con 2026 by head of Marvel Television Brad Winderbaum
Described as a global spy thriller set to debut on Disney+ in 2028
Reported to have a modest budget and aim to be more accessible to non‑fans
Production will begin filming in London in spring 2027
marvel_zodiac_series_details.why_it_matters: The series reflects a strategic shift toward lower‑budget, broader‑appeal MCU TV shows.

reincarnation_the_game_world_dan_katsu_a.headline: Reincarnation in the Game World Dan-Katsu
reincarnation_the_game_world_dan_katsu_a.summary: A teaser for the TV anime adaptation revealed additional cast members, theme song artists, and confirmed a January 2027 premiere.
highlights: MindaRyn performs the opening theme "Play the Play" and LINKL PLANET performs the ending theme "My Life Story"
New cast includes Ayaka Nanase as Hanna, Kotone Izumi as Sierra, Hikaru Iida as Lana, and Chihaya Asakura as Ester
Yūto Uemura (credited as 上村祐翔) voices the protagonist Zephyrus
Directed by Nagisa Miyazaki with scripts by Yūji Kobayashi at STUDIO MASSKET
reincarnation_the_game_world_dan_katsu_a.why_it_matters: The added cast and music details deepen fan anticipation for the series' debut next year.

promise_me_the_spotlight_anime_reveals_v.headline: Promise Me the Spotlight
promise_me_the_spotlight_anime_reveals_v.summary: The anime adaptation of Promise Me the Spotlight revealed its key visual, teaser trailer, cast, and opening theme song.
highlights: Key visual and teaser trailer featuring the main cast were released
Yuika will perform the opening theme song “Nanimono demo nakatta Watashi dakara”
Seiji Kishi is directing with series composition by Yuko Kakihara
Team TillDawn is handling animation
promise_me_the_spotlight_anime_reveals_v.why_it_matters: The reveal provides the first look at the production team and music, building excitement for the upcoming series.

blue_eye_samurai_s2_2027_premiere.headline: Blue Eye Samurai Season 2
blue_eye_samurai_s2_2027_premiere.summary: Netflix announced that the second season of Blue Eye Samurai will premiere on January 19, 2027.
highlights: Season 2 will launch on Jan. 19, 2027, three years after the first season’s debut
The season will consist of six new episodes set in 1657 London
Returning cast includes Maya Erskine, Brenda Song, Darren Barnet and Masi Oka, with new voices Jonathan Pryce, Joel Kim Booster and Sherry Cola
An early renewal for a third and final season has been confirmed for 2028
blue_eye_samurai_s2_2027_premiere.why_it_matters: The announcement ends a three‑year wait for fans and confirms the series will conclude with a third season in 2028.

gunn_dcu_timeline_2026_02.headline: James Gunn Endorses Fan‑Created DCU Timeline Spanning 2016‑2027
gunn_dcu_timeline_2026_02.summary: Co‑head of DC Studios James Gunn replied affirmatively to a fan’s proposed DCU chronological order, effectively endorsing the timeline.
highlights: Gunn responded to a fan’s thread with “Timelines give me anxiety but I think this is pretty good,” confirming the list’s accuracy
The timeline places Lanterns episodes 1‑5 in 2016 and episodes 6‑8 in 2026, with key releases such as The Suicide Squad (May 2022), Blue Beetle (2023)
Two upcoming projects—Creature Commandos Season 2 and People vs. Gorilla Grodd—remain unplaced in the timeline
Gunn’s acknowledgment aligns with earlier statements that the DCU will function like a multiverse where audiences can enter at various points
gunn_dcu_timeline_2026_02.why_it_matters: The endorsement gives fans a clearer view of how the upcoming DCU films and series interconnect, guiding expectations for the next decade of content.

pero_pero_sparkles_anime_reveals_staff_j.headline: Pero Pero★Sparkles
pero_pero_sparkles_anime_reveals_staff_j.summary: The TV anime adaptation of Yurie Sekiya’s Pero Pero★Sparkles characters will premiere on TV Tokyo in January 2027.
highlights: Main cast includes Yuki Sakakihara (Mero), Mai Kanno (Kyun), Ai Fairouz (Ru) and Yōhei Azakami as narrator
Mao Miyashita directs the series at animation studio Usagiou
Series scripts are handled by Yūji Umoto with character designs by Shiomi Yano
Music is composed by Shōta Kowashi and produced by TV Tokyo Music
pero_pero_sparkles_anime_reveals_staff_j.why_it_matters: The project expands the popular mascot franchise into mainstream television, boosting its merchandise and brand reach.

superman_lois_star_whether_there_s_any_h.headline: Superman & Lois Cancellation Sparks Talk of Possible DCU Multiverse Cameo
superman_lois_star_whether_there_s_any_h.summary: The cancellation of Superman & Lois has led cast members to discuss the slim chance of a future multiverse cameo within the new DC Universe.
highlights: Superman & Lois was cancelled after four seasons despite strong viewership
Actress Emmanuelle Chiriqui, who played Lana Lang, said she wouldn’t rule out a multiverse cameo for the series’ cast
James Gunn hinted at multiverse possibilities during DC Studios’ Comic‑Con announcements
The series remains available for streaming on HBO Max
superman_lois_star_whether_there_s_any_h.why_it_matters: Fans are eager to see how legacy Arrowverse shows might be integrated into the evolving DCU narrative.

moments_the_friday_the_13th_franchise_we.headline: Castlevania: Nocturne Season 2
moments_the_friday_the_13th_franchise_we.summary: Netflix announced the premiere date for Castlevania: Nocturne Season 2, set for January 16, 2025.
highlights: The second season will debut on January 16, 2025 on Netflix.
Richter Belmont returns alongside Alucard and the rest of the cast.

david_harbour_confirms_dcu_return_as_fra.headline: Creature Commandos Season 2

angouleme_comic_con_2027.headline: Angoulême Bande Dessinée 2027 Festival

mobile_suit_gundam_changed_the_mecha_ani.headline: Gundam Rogue Orbit

nicolas_cage_breaks_silence_ryan_gosling.headline: Ghost Rider (MCU Reboot)

stranger_things_prequel_series_alongside.headline: Other Worlds

rainy_day_serenade_2027_ann.headline: Rainy Day Serenade

things_you_need_know_before_avatar_seven.headline: Avatar: Seven Havens Season 2

tv_years_ago_hbo_s_comic_book_masterpiec.headline: Watchmen (HBO series)
tv_years_ago_hbo_s_comic_book_masterpiec.summary: The HBO Watchmen series serves as a sequel to the original comics, addressing themes the 2009 film missed.
highlights: The nine‑episode series continues the story years after the original Watchmen comics
Created by Damon Lindelof as a direct sequel to Alan Moore and Dave Gibbons’ work, not the Zack Snyder film
It re‑examines the fake alien attack, Dr. Manhattan’s imprisonment of Ozymandias, and Rorschach’s legacy
Set against the backdrop of the Tulsa Race Massacre, the series explores systemic violence and extremist appropriation of the comics’ ideas
tv_years_ago_hbo_s_comic_book_masterpiec.why_it_matters: It demonstrates how a TV adaptation can more faithfully capture the source material’s core messages than a big‑screen version.

Snowball Earth Manga Heads to Final Arc, Exceeds 1 Million Copies in Circulation
posted on 2026-09-24 08:45 EDT by Joanna Cayanan
Manga launched in 2021, anime adaptation debuted on April 3
Manga author Yuhiro Tsujitsugu announced on their X (formerly Twitter) account on Thursday that their Snowball Earth manga has exceeded 1 million copies in circulation. Additionally, Tsujitsugu announced that the manga is starting its final arc. Tsujitsugu drew an illustration to celebrate the manga's 1 million milestone.

publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Akarui Mirai Kaihō and Kurageso launched the series in Houbunsha's Manga Time Kirara Forward magazine in August 2025. Kaihō writes the story while Kurageso draws the art. Houbunsha shipped the second compiled book volume on July 10.
The manga centers on Mirai, a girl who is not very good at socializing. A foul-mouthed AI from the future tells her she is going to die alone if she doesn't change, but Mirai isn't sure exactly how she is supposed to make friends.
Kaihō and Sadoru Chiba launched the original School-Live! manga in Manga Time Kirara Forward in 2012, and ended the series in November 2019. The manga's 12th and final compiled volume shipped in January 2020. Kaihō and Chiba launchedGakkō Gurashi! ~Otayori~, a sequel to the manga, in Manga Time Kirara Forward in June 2020, and ended it in August 2021.
Kaihō is also known for writing scripts for anime, and wrote the anime adaptation of his School-Live! manga. He was also the head writer on both Danganronpa 3 anime (as well as their "Hope Arc" special), was co-writer alongside Makoto Fukami on the anime adaptation of Fukami's Magical Girl Spec-Ops Asuka manga, and was also co-writer on the Akudama Drive original anime alongside its director Norimitsu Kaihō and Kurageso’s Akarui Mirai manga will conclude with its next chapter in the October 23 issue of Manga Time Kirara Forward. Chiikawa Anime Temporarily Pauses New Episodes for Revival Rebroadcast The official website for the anime of Nagano's Chiikawa manga announced on Friday that the anime will temporarily pause the regular airing of new episodes, and will instead run a "revival" rebroadcast of 25 older "influential" episodes until December 25. The revival rebroadcast will focus on episodes early in the anime's run, as well as episodes that are connected to the recent Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu (Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of Mermaid Island) anime film.
The Chiikawaanimepremiered in April 2022, and it previously aired every Friday withinFuji TV's morning news and entertainment program Mezamashi Terebi, before it began airing twice a week on Tuesdays and Fridays in April 2023. Sentai Filmworks licensed the anime, and is streaming it on HIDIVE with English subtitles. ODK Media's North American streaming platform Amasian TV began streaming a selection of 20 episodes from the anime on August 20.
Child actress Haruka Aoki (Liza in the Japanese dub of Mighty Express) voices the titular character Chiikawa as her first television anime voice acting role. Child actor Makoto Tanaka (Okko's Inn) voices Hachiware. Ari Ozawa voices Usagi.

However, his life changes dramatically one day after he enters into a contract with a shaman slave-girl, Nora, and later meets Coco, an elf who has lost all four limbs and five senses.
To save Coco, what began as a rescue attempt in a small workshop gradually escalates into a battle involving alchemy and sorcery, space and even the gods themselves—
The curtain now rises on this story, filled to the brim with “everything fantasy”!

Season 13 currently has the lowest Rotten Tomatoes audience score of all previous seasons.
American Horror Story's 13th season has a 32% audience score on Rotten Tomatoes. A critic score has not yet been compiled, but the show overall across seasons has a 77% critic score and a 64% audience score. Aside from 13, only four other seasons of the horror anthology series have garnered below a 60% Rotten Tomatoes audience score, with NYC (Season 11) at 42%, Double Feature (Season 10) at 50%, Cult (Season 7) at 52%, and Roanoke (Season 6) at 57%.
Season 13 Was Highly Anticipated
Unlike previous seasons of American Horror Story, which are mostly standalone stories, possibly with some tangential connection to a previous season, 13 connects to almost every tale told previously in the anthology series.

posted on  by Crystalyn Hodgkins
Bandai Namco Filmworks announced on Saturday that its planned new anime short for the Future GPX Cyber Formula series will screen alongside a new HD remastered "movie edition" of the Future GPX Cyber Formula: Early Days Renewal compilation OVA in Japan starting on February 19, 2027. The new short anime is titled Shin Seiki GPX Cyber Formula ASURADA, and is a direct sequel to the 1998 Future GPX Cyber Formula Sin anime.
Character designer Hirokazu Hisayuki and chief mechanical animation director Satoshi Shigeta drew the below poster for the new anime short.
Series director Mitsuo Fukuda is overseeing the new "movie edition" of Future GPX Cyber Formula: Early Days Renewal.

Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun First Theatrical Anime Film Project Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun is getting its first theatrical anime film project. The project announcement video was revealed during the DEVIL’S PARTY! 2 event held at Nippon Engineering College Arena in Tokyo on September 27.
Ayumu Murase, who voices Iruma Suzuki, shared the following comment:
“I think it’s going to develop into something that makes you wonder, ‘What’s going to happen!?’ I’m really looking forward to it myself, and I hope everyone will come out to see it as well. For now, I’ll do my best with the recording, so please look forward to it!”
Series creator Osamu Nishi also commented:
“More than anything, I’m really looking forward to it. I’ve been told by the people around me not to say anything, so I can’t really say anything (laughs), but we’re working very hard on it, so I hope you’ll wait patiently.”
You can watch the announcement video below.

We Are Aliens Film, Eri Short Anime, Candy Caries Win at Ottawa Int'l Animation Festival
posted on  by Joanna Cayanan
NOTHING NEW's We Are Aliens (Ware Ware wa Uchūjin) anime film, Honami Yano's Eri animated short, and Tomoki Misato and Wit Studio's original television anime Candy Caries were all awarded at the 50th Anniversary Awards Ceremony of the Ottawa International Animation Festival, on Saturday. We Are Aliens won the Grand Prize for Animated Feature, Eri won the Best Animated Short Award, and Candy Caries won at the Animation for Young Audiences 7+ Competition.
We Are Aliens opened in Japan on Friday. Kōhei Kadowaki directed the film. The film screened at the Directors' Fortnight of the Cannes Film Festival on May 14, and screened in competition at the Annecy International Animation Film Festival, which ran from June 21 to 27. publication_fingerprints.headline: One Piece
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
One Piece ONE PIECE TV anime announced a 2027 return following the release of Episode 1180, this year’s final episode, on September 27. The anime has concluded its run for this year, having returned after a 3-month break on April 5. Yuichi Nakamura was revealed as the voice of Loki, and he made his debut in the Elbaph Arc alongside the cast for the Knights of God.
Today’s episode is titled “Elbaph in Despair – Diabolical Covenant, ‘Domi Reversi’” and it is now streaming on Crunchyroll. You can see the end card for the episode below.
ONE PIECE manga by Eiichiro Oda first began in July 1997, and the series exceeded 600 million circulating copies worldwide in March this year. It also celebrated the 25th anniversary in 2022, while the anime adaptation started in October 1999 and is also still going strong.
The anime also debuted new theme songs for the ongoing arc. The opening song’s title is “Luminous,” and it’s performed by AiNA THE END. The ending song is “That Future” by Jisoku 36km.
Upcoming Projects
- A new LEGO special animation project releasing with two episodes on September 29
- Season 3 of the live-action series is set for 2027, having revealed new Alabasta cast recently

publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Long-Running Anime Series with 100+ Episodes Highlighted by CBR There is no shortage of outstanding anime series that don’t need more than a dozen episodes to fully captivate their audiences. However, considering how many of the medium’s all-time fan-favorite titles span hundreds of episodes, there’s no denying that ambitious, long-running anime series have their intrinsic appeal.
Long anime series are not for everyone; they are a substantial time commitment and seldom manage to keep their quality consistent without losing momentum or falling back on filler. However, among them, there exist remarkable examples of long-term storytelling that make sticking around for 100+ episodes worth it, to the point of viewers wishing these adventures could go on forever.
Hunter x Hunter Effortlessly Immerses Viewers in Its Subversive Shonen Adventure
Standing at 148 episodes, the 2011 adaptation of Hunter x Hunter weaves a brilliant story of adventure in an unpredictable world of wonder and darkness that, despite the series’ impressive length, still doesn’t cover the entire plot of Yoshihiro Togashi’s original manga. Dragon Ball DAIMA Dragon Ball fans can now look back at one of Goku's most unexpected looks almost four decades after it was introduced.
In a recent edition of the Toriyama Archives on the official Dragon Ball website, readers gotto check out one of the late, great Akira Toriyama's draft illustrations. The illustration in question, titled "Epic Jump Hero Battle! Watermelon Cutting Contest!" was originally crafted for Weekly Shōnen Jump No. 36 back in 1989; the art features Goku being blindfolded by Bulma while Master Roshi, Yamcha, Gohan, and Puar watch in excitement, and while Krillin scowls from his spot buried in the sand with half of a watermelon seated on his head.
Dragon Ball Reveals Rare Full-Color Look at Akira Toriyama’s 1989 Summer Goku
The art was republished via the Toriyama Archives along with a caption reading, "This special feature showcased popular Weekly Shōnen Jump characters enjoying a watermelon cutting contest, each in their own unique style. They are all depicted in swimwear, with some even sporting slight tans, which is a rare sight! As these images originally featured two-color printing, this draft is a special opportunity to see them in full color!"

publication_fingerprints.event_text:
The Mummy 4 Production is underway on The Mummy 4 ahead of the film's release in 2027. While the long wait continues for the sequel, new images have revealed a first look at Rachel Weisz's long-awaited return to the franchise.
Amid filming in the UK, Weisz was spotted filming scenes for her return as Evelyn O'Connell in The Mummy 4. Images of her in full costume were taken and have been quickly spreading online. Fans are very excited to see the photos, and it's no wonder why they are going viral. This is the first time Weisz has been seen in the role of Evelyn since appearing in the second Mummy movie in 2001, at which point she exited the franchise.
Brendan Fraser and Rachel Weisz Finally Reunite
The Mummy 4, which has not yet had its official title announced, reunites Weisz with franchise star Brendan Fraser. It's believed that the new sequel will ignore the third installment of the franchise, 2008's The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor. After Weisz played Evelyn in 1999's The Mummy and 2001's The Mummy Returns, she did not return for the third film. Her role was recast with Maria bello taking over.

Tetsuya Chiba Puts Hinemosu Notari Nikki Manga on Hiatus Due to Poor Health
posted on  by Joanna Cayanan
This year's 19th issue of Shogakukan's Big Comic magazine announced on Friday that Tetsuya Chiba's Hinemosu Notari Nikki manga will go on hiatus due to Chiba's poor health. The magazine's editorial staff stated that Chiba is eager to resume the manga's serialization as soon as possible, but the editorial department will prioritize Chiba's health and recovery.
In a separate statement by Chiba, he stated that the severe summer heat might be the cause of him feeling under the weather. Chiba added that he will focus on recovering to get back to drawing manga again. He apologizes for the worry he has caused, and asks for the readers' patience as he takes some time to recover.
Chiba launched the autobiographical short essay manga in Big Comic in December 2015. AD Police Files (1990) 4K Restoration Bubblegum Crisis was one of the premier cyberpunk anime franchises of its day, known for its signature, almost sacrilegious use of bright colors and a pop music-esque aesthetic within the genre. Now, its contentious sequel is getting a modernized update, and the upgraded version finally has a release date.
AD Police Files was known for being very different compared to Bubblegum Crisis, but it's since become a cult classic in its own right. A modern 4K restoration of the 1990s OVA is on the way, offering viewers a better glimpse at its grit and gore. The newly released trailer is just a taste of how beautiful it still is, and the 4K edition is the version fans have waited over three decades for.
One of the Most Brutal '90s Cyberpunk OVAs Gets a 4K Upgrade
Announced at Anime Expo 2026 by AnimeEigo, the 4K version of AD Police Files comes from the OVA's original negative. This was one of five announcements at the event, though it's easily the most notable.
Set to be released as a Blu-ray and UHD combo pack, this version of AD Police Files will include the original Japanese dub (with English subtitles), the US English dub, the UK English dub and more. publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Everyone’s Darling Has a Secret Everyone’s Darling Has a Secret manga is getting an anime series. A visual was revealed, along with the main staff and cast, and an April 2027 release date. Studio Gekko is animating the series.
The voice cast consists of:
- Reiji Kawashima as Hizashi Hiruno
- Hikaru Tono as Rei Kuromiya
- Iori Noguchi as Sakura Akai
- Ami Maeshima as Sora Konno
Hikaru Sato is directing the anime with Fumihiko Shimo in charge of the series scripts. Kibidango 14-go is the character designer, while Satoru Kosaki and MONACA compose the music.
Kashiko Amane writes and illustrates the manga that the anime is based on. Hakusensha is publishing the manga since September 2022. Yen Press is licensing it in English, describing the plot as follows:
Hizashi Hiruno, a freshman at a super-elite high school, has just finished his first academic proficiency test of the year. He anxiously awaits the results, which will set the tone for his next three years at school. But due to a mistake on his answer sheet, he receives an abysmal score and gets sent to remedial lessons! If there’s one silver lining, he’s not the only one—and his comrade could be the girl of his dreams?!

Pokémon Winds & Waves Regional Dex Reveal Pokémon Winds and Waves likely won't be receiving any additional updates until early 2027. Thankfully, through various sources, both official and unofficial, quite a bit is known about the Generation 10 games, especially where the Pokémon are concerned.
Between old favorites and new friends, a total of 54 Pokémon have been revealed as part of the Regional Dex for Pokémon Winds and Waves. This list includes some obvious suspects, some more out there choices fans might not expect and, of course, already beloved additions to the franchise like the new Starter Trio, Pombon, Browt, and Gecqua.
54 Pokémon Officially Confirmed For Pokémon Winds and Waves
The Pokémon most prominently featured in the announced trailer for Pokémon Winds and Waves were, unsurprisingly, the new Starter Trio and the franchise's eternal mascot. Pombon, the Fire-type, Browt, the Grass-type, and Gecqua, the Water-type, have quickly won the hearts of fans, with fans in mass speculating about what their evolutions will look like. Pikachu, meanwhile, will not only be catchable as always, but two specific Pikachus are being featured as prominent characters in the games.

Uma Musume Anime Aims for Guinness World Record with New Series
posted on 2026-09-28 23:00 EDT by Ken Iikura-Gross
Will the horse girls achieve Most Speaking Characters in a Short-form Animation Series Based on a Video Game?
The Uma Musume Pretty Derbyfranchise boldly announced on Sunday that it is going for the Guinness World Record for the "Most Speaking Characters in a Short-form Animation Series Based on a Video Game" with the new short anime series Umayuru Full Gate! The staff said that Guinness World Records will reveal if Umayuru Full Gate! has broken the record in March 2027.
Umayuru Full Gate! is the sequel to 2022's Uma Yuru. The anime premiered on the franchise's YouTube channel on Friday. Episodes follow broadcasts of PakaLive TV.
The Uma Musume Pretty Derby mobile game inspired both Uma Yuru and Uma Yuru: Full Gate! The Uma Musume Pretty Derby game launched in February 2021 for iOS and Android. Sumikko Gurashi debuted in 2012 as slightly negative characters who like to stay in the corner of a room. The characters include "Shirokuma," a polar bear who is sensitive to cold; "Penguin?" (with a question mark in its name), a penguin who is unsure if it is actually a penguin; "Tonkatsu," a piece of pork cutlet that was left uneaten; "Neko," a shy cat; and "Tokage," who hides his nature as one of the last dinosaurs.
The first anime film, titled Sumikkogurashi – Good to be in the corner, opened in Japan in November 2019. Obocchama‑kun Reborn TV Asahi announced on Thursday that Yoshinori Kobayashi's Obocchama-kun manga is getting a new television anime titled Obocchama-kun Reborn in 2027. The company unveiled a teaser promotional video and visual:
Chie Kōjiro is reprising the role of the protagonist Obocchama-kun from the original 1989 anime.
Green Gold Animation is producing the new anime with cooperation from Shinei Animation and Sony Pictures Networks India, who worked on the 2025 India-produced anime. The new anime is a joint production between Japan and India. The new anime will feature stories that were not adapted from the original manga, as well as new stories supervised by series creator Kobayashi.
The Obocchama-kun anime's YouTube channel describes the original 1989 series:
The extremely crude Obocchama(Obo Cchama / 'Obocchama-Kun') is the heir of the wealthy Obo family and a new student at the elite Denenchofu Academy. The teaser announces the anime's first cast members, as well as its April 2027 television premiere.

When she meets Ichikura, an inconspicuous black-haired boy with glasses, he looks like a normal, nice guy. But it turns out that back in junior high he was a nefarious delinquent!
He keeps assuring her that he's changed his ways, but he's still pretty quick to pick fights! Has Ichikura really turned over a new leaf? And will Momose keep quiet about his rowdy past?

New York Public Library Announces Best New Comics of 2026 We spend a lot of time reminding people of the importance of bringing new readers into libraries, especially those in their younger years. Through them, we get a sense of what moves a community, what interests them or worries them or even makes them dream. It’s simple, libraries inform and reveal the cultural waylines of a people. The more readers we get, the more we know about what’s occupying our minds.
One group of readers that doesn’t always get the same level of attention but is just as crucial to the readership conversation are librarians, the people who curate and purchase the books we can check out at our local book temples. Their ability to engage with the wide range of genres, formats, and styles largely dictates what’s available on shelves. They are among some of the most voracious readers in existence.
The New York Public Library has put together a list of the best new comics of 2026 based on librarian input and feedback. It’s a special list as it offers a glimpse into the reading habits, intellectual leanings, and potential fandoms shared among NYC’s book ambassadors. As such, it is an infectious selection of comics.

publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Kagurabachi Anime Casts Yūichi Nakamura Viz Media's Shonen Jump service and Shueisha's MANGA Plus service are releasing the Kagurabachi manga digitally in English. MANGA Plus describes the story:
Young Chihiro spends his days training under his famous swordsmith father. One day he hopes to become a great sword-maker himself. The goofy father and the serious son--they thought these days would last forever. But suddenly, tragedy strikes. A dark day soaked in blood. Chihiro and his blade now live only for revenge. Epic sword battle action!
The anime will premiere in April 2027, and will stream that month worldwide excluding Japan, Mainland China, North Korea, and South Korea. The "world tour" event for the anime began this past July at Anime Expo in Los Angeles, Japan Expo Paris in Paris, ANImagic in Mannheim, Germany, and in August at Anime NYC in New York. The event is showing the first 20 minutes of the first episode, and will end in Japan in spring 2027 where the full first episode will be screened.
Hokazono debuted the Kagurabachi manga in Shueisha's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in September 2023. Shueisha published the manga's 12th compiled volume in Japan on September 4. publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Warner Bros. to Disappear After Mega-Merger with Paramount Skydance Warner Bros. is officially disappearing. After the upcoming mega-merger with Paramount Skydance, not only is Warner Bros. losing its identity, but it's losing its core people.
Per a new report by Puck News, the Warner Bros. everyone knows is ending. The mega-merger is set to be completed on Oct. 6, and David Ellis just revealed the new merger will happen under the new label Skydance, which will continue to oversee the two separate companies. However, as the mega-merger marches forward, it will be without Warner Bros.' Motion Picture Chairs Michael De Luca and Pam Abdy.
Skydance Will Have New Leaders
Paramount Motion Picture co-chairs, Josh Greenstein and Dana Goldberg, will reportedly oversee both Warner Bros. and Paramount under the new merger, with the former WB heads set to make their exit. Deadline reports the duo didn't know their fate until Oct. 1. Ellison reportedly never reached out to them.
This comes after Warner Bros.' most recent big release, Tom Cruise's panned social satire Digger, is an epic flop, expected to lose between $125 million and $160 million. 7th Be Forever Yamato: Rebel 3199 Film Reveals Ending Theme Song With Music Video
posted on  by Alex Mateo
Bandai Namco Filmworks announced on Friday that Junko Yagami is performing the ending theme song "Haruka e, Eien e" (To the Distance, To Eternity) for Nijiiro no Rinne (Rainbow-Colored Reincarnation), the seventh film in Yamato yo Towa ni: Rebel 3199 (Star Blazers: Be Forever Yamato - Rebel 3199), the latest project in the Space Battleship Yamato remakes. The company streamed a music video for the song:
Yagami previously performed an ending theme song for the 1983 Final Yamato film.
The company also unveiled a rainbow-colored visual featuring the characters:
The films' character designer Nobuteru Yūki drew the main visual (pictured right).
The film will open in theaters in Japan on October 30. The overall anime is premiering as seven films. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime under the title Star Blazers: Space Battleship Yamato 3199.
The sixth film, Aoi Meikyū (Blue Labyrinth), opened on June 26. In the story, the Yamato passes through a space time node that brings the main characters to the year 2026 in the present-day Reiwa era in Tokyo.

Street Fighters (The Asylum) After the official trailer for The Asylum‘s Street Fighters, the mockbuster film is out now. The flick arrives on digital on October 2— just two weeks before Capcom‘s big-budget Street Fighter film hits theaters on October 16.
For those unversed, The Asylum specializes in low-budget films that copy the titles and release dates of major Hollywood blockbusters. Street Fighters inevitably serves as a mockbuster to capitalize on Legendary and Paramount’s big-budget Street Fighter movie.
Directed by Brian Nowak from a script penned by Jacob Cooney and Jason White, this knockoff film sees the world’s best martial artists gather for a championship organized by a mysterious group, only to realize that they are fighting for their lives against a sinister plot.
The plot of the original game-based Street Fighter, on the other hand, reads, “Set in 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu (Andrew Koji) and Ken Masters (Noah Centineo) are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li (Callina Liang) recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. Berserk Ultimate Premium Masterline Slan Statue The Berserk franchise is no stranger to high-end collectibles, particularly those that perfectly showcase the brand's sometimes "racy" elements. Such is the case with the newest creation from Prime 1 Studio, which is a truly striking work of art.
Coming in at a 1/4 scale, the Ultimate Premium Masterline Slan: The Princess of the Uterine Sea is based mostly on her first appearance in the Berserk manga, with the visuals as harrowing as they are breathtaking. While not the first time that the company has produced a statue for the character, this one is a completely new sculpt.
Now available for pre-order and ready to rise within the next two years, the DX version of this collectible is one that fans will want to hurry and summon.
Berserk's Nearly 3-Foot Slan Statue Recreates Her Harrowing Eclipse Appearance
Based on her first appearance as a member of the God Hand, Ultimate Premium Masterline Slan: The Princess of the Uterine Sea evokes her as if she truly is appearing during the Eclipse. The most prominent part of the statue is her gigantic black wings, with these subtly creating a silhouette around her as they reach into the base.

Alice Oseman's Heartstopper Mini-Comics Get A Full Colour Hardcover
Alice Oseman's Heartstopper Mini-Comics are to get the full colour hardcover treatment from Hachette next year
While Alice Oseman's best-selling Heartstopper YA graphic novels were coming out from Hachette, based on her earlier webcomics and self-published comics, Alice Oseman kept putting out mini-comics set in the Heartstopper world as well, though they were much harder to come by. But that was then.
Now, Hachette Children's Group has announced Heartstopper: The Mini-Comics, a new full-colour collection of Oseman's mini-comics that includes two exclusive, brand-new stories. It continues Hachette's long-running partnership with Oseman, which began when the publisher acquired the print rights to the series after its successful webcomic and Kickstarter origins. Heartstopper follows the relationship between Nick Nelson and Charlie Spring and their circle of friends, and has become a global phenomenon across comics, television, and publishing. Volume 6, the final main instalment of the core series, was released in 2026. publication_fingerprints.headline: Because I, the True Saint, was Banished, that Country is Done For!
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Because I, the True Saint, was Banished, that Country is Done For! Kodansha USA Publishing started releasing Matsu's manga adaptation in English digitally in 2024. Kodansha USA describes the story:
Ever since she was a child, Eliane has been the saint and protector of the Kingdom of Belkheim, warding off monsters and ensuring bountiful harvests with her prayers. But when a pretender saint beguiles the foolish prince—to whom she is engaged—into believing she is nothing but a fraud, he calls off the marriage and banishes her from the kingdom. Homeless and penniless but free to chart her own course for the first time in her life, Eliane decides to make for the neighboring kingdom, where she hopes to blend in as a commoner and lead a quiet life…but a chance encounter on the road will totally upend her modest plans.
Utsuzawa launched the story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in June 2020. Kodansha began publishing the light novels with illustrations by Pukyunosuke in January 2021. The seventh volume shipped in Japan in December 2024.
Mokuba Matsu's manga adaptation debuted April 2021 in Kodansha's Palcy app. Kodansha released the manga's 13th compiled book volume on July 30. K MANGA is also publishing the manga in English.

Ascendance of a Bookworm Part 4 Yuka Iguchi and Show Hayami returned in the Part 3 anime as Rozemyne (previously Myne) and Ferdinand, respectively. The anime's new cast members included:
The first anime season premiered in October 2019, and ended in December 2019 with 14 episodes. The second season premiered in Japan in April 2020. The anime's third season premiered in April 2022. Crunchyroll streamed all three seasons as they aired.
Kazuki began the original novels on the "Shōsetsuka ni Narō" website in 2013, and ended the web novel in 2017. You Shiina illustrates the print edition. The main series ended with its 33rd volume (volume 12 of part 5) in December 2023. The novel series now has over 13 million copies in circulation (including digital copies).
J-Novel Club is releasingboth the light novels and some of the various manga adaptations in English.

This Is the End Stagnation Committee Light Novels Have Anime in the Works
posted on 2026-10-03 11:11 EDT by Egan Loo
Kien Aien's story of youths taking on the coming apocalypse
The "Dengeki Bunko Fall Festival Online 2026" announced on Saturday that Kien Aien's Kochira, Shūmatsu Teitai Iinkai. (This Is the End Stagnation Committee.) light novel series has an anime in the works.
The story imagines if our world is actually in the middle of an apocalypse, unbeknownst to most people. Weird creatures beneath Tokyo's Shinobazu Pond, a giant snail perched on the Eiffel Tower, a demon lord who looks like a beautiful girl …. Yet, in the underbelly of society, there are boys and girls who fight the coming apocalypse while giving it the middle finger. They can't cancel the apocalypse, and they can only delay it. Still, they take their arms into battle. Why? To them, this is just day-to-day life, a ritual festival every day for the young.

The photos, which have been spreading on social media, appear to be from a scene where Pattinson's Bruce Wayne faces a crowd of angry protesters in Gotham. They seem to be no fans of Bruce after the events of The Batman, with people holding signs with messages like, "Death to billionaires." Members of the press are also taking photos of the secret vigilante as he is escorted through the crowd by security. Along with revealing a look at Pattinson back as Bruce, the images also hint at the unrest in the city when The Batman Part II picks up.
Robert Pattinson Will Be Joined by Other Familiar Faces
Pattinson is one of several stars of the first movie confirmed to return for The Batman Part II. He'll be joined by Jeffrey Wright as James Gordon, Andy Serkis as Alfred Pennyworth, and Colin Farrell as The Penguin. It is rumored that Barry Keoghan will also return as the Joker, but that hasn't been confirmed. Take Charge of My Heart The web novel-based live-action Korean seriesTake Charge of My Heart released its main trailer on September 28, ahead of its October 9 premiere.

Bo-bae discovers that her electric ability has no effect on Ho-rang, while Ho-rang discovers that staying near her can recharge his artificial heart battery. The two eventually enter into a three-month contract involving physical contact so that Bo-bae can help keep Ho-rang's battery charged before his next surgery.
The newly released trailer follows Bo-bae as she meets Ho-rang, the only person immune to her electrical powers. After discovering that his battery recharges around her, Ho-rang proposes a three-month contract to stay together, saying he needs her help to survive.

Civil War II #3 – The Death of the Hulk (June 2016) In every Look Back, we examine a comic book issue from 10/25/50 years ago (plus a wild card every month with a fifth week in it). This time around, I'm a bit late as I look at July 2016's shocking death of the Hulk during the Civil War II crossover event.
In the last decade or so, comic book fans have grown accustomed to the corporate synchronicity between the world of comic books and the world of comic book FILMS, where comic book companies figure that it makes sense to tie the events of the comic books to the events of the very popular movies based on their characters. There tends not to be as much of an overlap as you would think, but it is totally reasonable for the companies to still want to try it (after all, there was a HUGE boom in Batman comic book sales when the Batman movie came out, so why NOT chase that hope?).
Therefore, when Captain America: Civil War came out, loosely adapting the hit Marvel crossover event, it made sense to do a sequel to that event, and while Civil War II definitely didn't hit the same way as the original event, it still ended up having a major impact on the Marvel Universe, especially with the death of the Hulk in June 2016's Civil War II #3 by B In July 2016, Civil War II #3 depicted the controversial death of Bruce Banner, sparking major debate in the Marvel Universe. Zoids: Chaotic Century manga to conclude with new chapters in 2027 Zoids: Chaotic Century is officially set to continue with brand-new chapters after more than two decades.
Per Inside Games, manga artist Michiro Ueyama has announced that he will be producing the final chapter of the Zoids: Chaotic Century manga series next year. The original Zoids: Chaotic Century manga ran from 1999 to 2001 in the pages of Monthy CoroCoro Comic, while Ueyama produced his own fan manga, Zoids EX: Chaotic Century, around the same time via his personal website.
Zoids: Chaotic Century's Original Manga Artist Confirms Return of the Story in 2027
Zoids EX: Chaotic Century was discontinued shortly after it began, and was an unofficially produced title, yet it will serve as the basis for the Zoids: Chaotic Century finale after Ueyama received the official blessing of Takara Tomy, which owns the rights to the Zoids franchise. While details regarding the plot of the upcoming finale remain under wraps, those familiar with Ueyama's work will likely have a good idea of what to expect from the series when it returns in 2027.

The series’ official website announced the adaptation and confirmed that WIT Studio will continue the animation production.
J-Novel summarizes the first volume of part 4 as follows: 
Rozemyne has awoken from her two-year slumber. Everything and everyone has changed, which is as terrifying as it sounds, but she doesn’t have time to waste before she’s thrust toward the Royal Academy—a requirement for becoming a noble. There, she will meet all sorts of colorful teachers and students from other duchies… but can she keep her composure in the face of the most books she’s seen yet? Our bookworm goes to school in the newest installment of this biblio-fantasy by book lovers, for book lovers.
The first season of the anime aired in 2019, followed by a second in 2020 and a third in 2022, all animated by Studio Ajia-do. The latest Season aired in spring and summer 2026, with the last episode airing on October 3, 2026, and was animated by Studio WIT.

Marvel's New "Renown" Line announced today at New York Comic Con Retailer Day is intended to be kept in print which makes a nice change
Article Summary
- Marvel’s new Renown line was announced at NYCC Retailer Day as a paperback-focused collection range meant to stay in print.
- The Marvel Renown program marks a major shift for Marvel, with select books planned as evergreen editions and some in hardcover.
- First Marvel Renown titles include Punisher: Suicide Run, Daredevil: The Devil in Cell-Block D, and All-New Hawkeye.
- NYCC Retailer Day highlighted Marvel’s Renown line alongside the new Marvel Brick format during the business-focused Javits event.
As well as the Marvel Brick line announced at the New York Comic Con Retailer Day, Marvel Comics also gave details to the assembled comic book retailers about their new Marvel Renown line, collections intended to be kept in print perpetually. This is quite a new thing for Marvel Comics; they are really not used to it.

publication_fingerprints.headline: Ghost of Tsushima: Legends Anime
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Ghost of Tsushima: Legends Anime Sucker Punch Productions and SIE released Ghost of Tsushima on PlayStation 4 in July 2020, on PlayStation 5 in August 2021, and on PC in May 2024. The game is a fictionalization of the historical 1274 Mongol invasion of the island of Tsushima, and follows samurai Jin Sakai, the sole survivor of his clan, as he fights a guerilla war against the invading Mongols. The game has a sequel titled Ghost of Yōtei that launched in October 2025, with the story set more than 300 years later in 1603 in Hokkaido.
Ghost of Tsushima: Legends is a multiplayer addition to the original game that debuted in October 2020, and became available separate from the original game in September 2021. Unlike the historical setting of the original game, the multiplayer game focuses on Japanese folklore and mythology.

Comisma Enters Agreement With Akili International to Produce Live-Action Film of Zukyun x Bakyun Manga
posted on 2026-10-09 03:34 EDT by Rafael Antonio Pineda
Robby Monroe to direct, script film based on Teito Yuzuriha's manga
Image courtesy of Seven SeasPublishing company Comisma (ComicSmart, Inc.) announced on Thursday that it has entered into an agreement with London-based company Akili International to develop and produce an English live-action film of Teito Yuzuriha's Zukyun x Bakyun manga. Robby Monroe has been "engaged" to direct the film and pen the screenplay.
Dan and Lyla are two highly trained, elite assassins who work together on the most dangerous of missions. They've only ever interacted on the job, so when Dan suddenly confesses his love for Lyla, the two find themselves up against something they have zero training for: romance! With their lives and hearts on the line, can this killer couple continue breaking bones without breaking each other's hearts?

The official website for the television anime of author Kennoji and artist R_ringo's My Sword Saint Master Is Too Cute to Live With! The teaser announces the anime's cast and January 2027 television premiere.
Ai Kakuma as Liza Parsandra
Seena Hoshiki as Eugene Dawson
Hitomi Ueda as Cordelia Dawson
Azusa Tsujimori as Erin Toa
Tomoyo Takayanagi as Meris Eclipse
Miyu Tomita as Fiona Rosso

Hitomi Ueda is also the anime's narrator.
Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the manga and will release the manga starting in June 2027 as part of its Ghost Ship imprint. Seven Seas Entertainment describes the series:

publication_fingerprints.headline: Crunchyroll, HAYATE, LINE Digital Frontier Partner to Produce Anime of Around 15 Webtoons
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Crunchyroll, HAYATE, LINE Digital Frontier Partner to Produce Anime of Around 15 Webtoons Crunchyroll will exclusively stream the anime made through this partnership in select territories.
HAYATE Inc. was founded in March 2025 and is headquartered in Tokyo. Aniplex's Masanori Miyake leads the venture as Chairman and CEO along with President and COO Leo Watanabe. The staff is composed of Aniplex and Crunchyroll employees. HAYATE is focusing specifically on planning, developing, and producing anime content for Crunchyroll's streaming platform worldwide. In April, HAYATEacquired all shares of anime studio Lay-duce, making it a wholly owned subsidiary. HAYATE is overseeing the production of the upcoming Ghost of Tsushima: Legends (Ghost of Tsushima: Kuroudo Kitan) anime series.
LINE Digital Frontier CEO Shin-bae Kim had announced in February 2025 that the company would produce 20 animated adaptations of webtoons that year, significantly expanding its webtoon-based IP business. LINE Digital Frontier is the operator of LINE Manga, the Japanese subsidiary of Naver Webtoon.
LINE Manga has been aggressively pursuing webtoon adaptations since 2024. In 2024, it produced 12 adaptations, a significant increase from just one in 2022 and two in 2023.
― Thursday, October 8 News Dark Ho Crunchyroll, HAYATE and LINE Digital Frontier announced a partnership to adapt roughly 15 webtoons into anime

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Dragon Ball Super: Beerus finally premiered today, Sunday, Oct. 11, 2026, on numerous streaming platforms, including Crunchyroll in the U.S. After nearly a decade of anticipation, the long-awaited return of Dragon Ball Super is once again "breaking the internet," as the kids would say.
Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Episode 1 is now streaming worldwide on multiple platforms, with Crunchyroll and Hulu offering same-day access in the U.S. However, in a bit of déjà vu, the highly anticipated premiere caused serious technical issues for North American Crunchyroll subscribers and the French anime streaming platform Animation Digital Network (ADN). As Anime Updates (@animeupdates) reported on X (formerly Twitter), many Crunchyroll users saw a technical difficulty message when trying to watch Episode 1 immediately after its release. ADN also acknowledged server issues, stating, "We're experiencing difficulties with our server; our teams have been notified. Sorry for the inconvenience."
This is hardly a new phenomenon for Dragon Ball. The Rookie Season 9 Premiere Date Announced The Rookie has been keeping fans on the edge of their seats since Season 8 ended on a shocking cliffhanger in May. Months after the finale, the Season 9 premiere date has finally been announced.
ABC has announced at New York Comic-Con that its hit procedural will officially return for its ninth season on Wednesday, Jan. 6, 2027. The Disney-owned network renewed The Rookie for Season 9 in April, just a month before the Season 8 finale. News of the premiere date comes five months after the eighth season ended on a cliffhanger that no fans saw coming.
The Rookie’s Season 9 Premiere Date Continues a Trend
ABC confirmed over the summer that The Rookie would be held for midseason 2027. This marks the third time the Nathan Fillion-led drama wouldn’t be coming back in the fall. Beginning with Season 7 in 2024, The Rookie has been premiering its seasons in January. The 18-episode seasons have aired consecutively, meaning there haven’t been any breaks, or, if necessary, a break no longer than a week or two.
This will be the fifth time that The Rookie has premiered during midseason. The first was for Season 3 in 2021 following COVID. Darkhold Destiny Wizards of the Coast has released more information regarding the newest Marvel set, Darkhold Destiny, including a first look at some of the cards in the set, as well as the announcement of the writing team for the tie in comic. During the “Bullpen Bulletins! with Stephen Wacker” panel at New York Comic Con, WotC and Marvel teamed up to announce the third Universes Beyond set inspired by the comics, focused on the magical side of the Marvel Universe. This new set features characters that have not been previously depicted in Magic, including a brand new character created for the narrative. Wizards also announced a number of Darkhold Destiny products for every kind of player.
From the Collector Booster Box packaging, we can see that the Time Stone will be the headliner card for the set. Each previous Marvel set has featured a different Infinity Stone, with Spider-Man including the Soul Stone and Marvel Super Heroes including the Mind Stone.
The revealed Darkhold Destiny cards feature a few of the characters and locations present in the story. Michael E. Uslan, Steven S. DeKnight & Sebastián Cabrol Revive Dr Syn
Michael E. Uslan, Steven S. DeKnight and Sebastián Cabrol resurrect Dr Syn in comics for Oni Press in 2027
Oni Press has announced Dr. Syn, a four-issue comic book miniseries that reintroduces Russell Thorndike's early 20th-century proto-pulp vigilante to modern readers. Co-written by Michael E. Uslan, executive producer of the Batman films, and Steven S. DeKnight of Daredevil, with art by Sebastián Cabrol of EC's Catacomb of Torment), the series is set to debut with issue #1 in January 2027.
Originally introduced in Thorndike's 1915 novel Doctor Syn: A Tale of the Romney Marsh, Reverend Doctor Christopher Syn waged a guerrilla campaign against King George III as the Scarecrow of Romney Marsh after the deaths of his family. Previous adaptations included stage plays, films, and Disney's 1963 television serial starring Patrick McGoohan, which also spawned a Gold Key comic. Oni describes this new version as the character's first major appearance in the 21st century and the first time the British figure has been brought to American shores.

Osamu Tezuka's Phoenix (Hi no Tori) – Future Arc Stage Play News
Osamu Tezuka's Phoenix Manga's Future Arc Gets Stage Play in February
posted on  by Alex Mateo
Osamu Tezuka's Phoenix (Hi no Tori) manga is inspiring another stage play that will run at Sakura Hall in Shibuya Cultural Centre Owada in Tokyo from February 6-8. The play Hi no Tori Mirai-hen ZEROMDISTANCE (Phoenix Future Arc ZEROMDISTANCE) adapts the manga's "Future" arc.
The play stars Jutta Yuki as Masato, Narumi Yasuda as the voice of the Phoenix, Moro Morooka as Dr. Saruta, Adone Kudō and Shiina Yuzuki as Tamami, and Kaiki Ohara as Rock.
Ryusei Kudoh is directing and writing the play. He is also serving as executive producer. Ryo Oguri is producing. Nao'ymt is handling the music.
Tezuka wrote Phoenix's "Future" arc between December 1967 and September 1968. The official Osamu Tezuka website describes the second part:
Set in A.D. 3404, the earth is dying, and human beings inhabit a city-state built deep under the ground. The authorities search for Yamanobe Masato, Class 2 space warrior of Megalopolis Yamato. They suspect him of hiding Tamami, a girl transformed into a human from her original form as the outer space creature Moopie.

publication_fingerprints.headline: Yumene Connect
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Yumene Connect Ko Sawada’s manga, Yumene Connect, is getting an anime adaptation. A teaser visual and trailer were also released along with the main staff and cast. Studio Massket is animating the series.
Yu Sasahara and Yusuke Kobayashi star in the series as Nano and Yuhi Takamiya, respectively. Sota Yokote is directing with Gigaemon Ichikawa on the script and series composition. Yoshihiro Watanabe is the character designer and Hayato Matsumura is the music composer.
The manga began serialization in Kodansha’s Weekly Shonen Magazine in September 2024. It currently has nine volumes in circulation and the 10th volume is slated to release on October 16, 2026. 
The story follows Yuhi Takamiya, a first-year high school student who misses his entire first week of school because of a sudden illness and worries he won’t make any friends. After hearing his plight, an alien named Nano arrives to help him. Nano eventually moves in with Yuhi, along with another alien lifeform named Nyoru Puppu Panpippi.
Source: Official Website, X (formerly Twitter)

But one day, Tetsuya comes home to find Tama has grown gigantic! And instead of a peaceful night, Tama takes him on an adventure to defeat the boss of a nearby dungeon! From racing around at high speeds with Tetsuya on his back to granting buffs through purring, it seems that Tama has awakened some extraordinary powers—and Tetsuya decides to livestream this new, exciting life! It's not long before the pair save a beautiful young streamer, making their dungeon-clearing streams go viral. Now, all eyes are on Tetsuya and his giant cat Tama! What will they get up to next?

As is typical since its debut, the next season went into production as new episodes debuted. However, in a stunning show of faith, the streamer renewed the show for a sixth season before the fifth even completed filming.
The hulking hero Lee Child created is only growing in popularity off-screen, too. Andrew Child's 30th novel in the series hit bookshelves in October, with another on the way. Meanwhile, Frances Neagley will get her first standalone novel, Zero Margin, in 2027, co-written by Yasmin Angoe and Lee Child. Just shy of 30 years after the first book debuted, the character has never been more popular and is on his way to becoming a genuine cultural institution.
In 2026, Reacher Became A Bona Fide Franchise For Prime Video

AD Police Files 4K Ultra HD & Blu‑ray Set One of the best entries in the original Bubblegum Crisis saga is returning in just a few months as an upgraded version that old-school cyberpunk sci-fi fans won't want to miss.
As its official Amazon Prime page shows, the highly anticipated 4K Ultra HD and Blu-ray release of AD Police Files is coming much sooner than fans expected. The AD Police Files 4K Ultra HD and Blu-ray set will be available on Jan. 12, 2027, leaving fans less than three months to wait before they can bring the upgraded cyberpunk action home.
Bubblegum Crisis' First Spinoff Returns in 4K With January Release Date
Animated by Artmic and AIC, AD Police Files premiered in 1990 as the first spinoff of the hit Bubblegum Crisis anime series. The three-part prequel takes place five years before the events of Bubblegum Crisis and largely follows the early days of Advanced Police inspector Leon McNichol's career.
AD Police Files picks up with McNichol in the midst of a battle against a raging Boomer, the franchise's humanoid androids. publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Arc System Works Opens New Studio Takumi Arc System Works announced on Thursday it will open Arc System Works Tokyo Studio "Takumi," its new development studio, on November 2. The company stated that it has decided to open a new studio to dramatically strengthen development capabilities across the company, beginning with a new fighting game that has been selected for the "IP360" subsidy project of Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI).
The company added that the new studio is a "strategic cornerstone for going beyond existing conventional game development frameworks and delivering an overwhelming sense of 'ultimate excitement' to players around the world." Additionally, the company envisions the studio as a collaboration hub with a widespread global reach. The company also announced that it is expanding its recruitment of creators with the opening of the new studio.
Arc System Works also recently released the Donutalgame on PC via Steam on September 3 (September 4 in Japan).
Arc System Works also announced on October 10 the PlayStation 5 release for its Blazblue: CentralFiction fighting game.

Narnia: The Magician’s Nephew (Netflix) Over three years after the project was announced, Netflix has finally released the first trailer for Greta Gerwig's Narnia: The Magician's Nephew. The film is a reboot of The Chronicles of Narnia franchise, adapting the chronologically earliest novel in C. S. Lewis' The Chronicles of Narnia series. Though its release is still months away, The Magician's Nephew has already proven controversial due to its significant deviations from the source material, especially in terms of visuals.
Gerwig has transplanted the story, originally set in the 1900s, into the 1950s, and she has infused it with a rock-and-roll aesthetic. This even applies to The Magician's Nephew's main antagonist, the future White Witch, Jadis. However, one shot from the latest trailer revealed an alteration to the film's version of Jadis that should make fans of The Chronicles of Narnia very happy.
The Magician's Nephew Introduced a Divisive Redesign for Jadis
Throughout most of the trailer as well as earlier promotional materials, Jadis' costume was highly unusual. She wore a short dress made of reflective, diamond-shaped panels along with metal armor on her arms and a pair of shiny silver go-go boots. Jun Maeda Enters Palliative Care for Pharyngeal Cancer News
Kanon, Air, Clannad, Heaven Burns Red's Jun Maeda in Palliative Care for Pharyngeal Cancer
posted on  by Rafael Antonio Pineda
Visual Arts/Key announced on Monday that writer and composer Jun Maeda (Kanon, Air, Clannad, Angel Beats!) has been diagnosed with pharyngeal cancer, and has chosen to focus on palliative care, after considering his condition and the outlook for possible treatment.
The announcement also included an e-mail and mailing address for fans to send Maeda a message or letter of encouragement. The staff will accept letters only, and asked fans to refrain from sending gifts or other get-well items. The staff added Maeda is currently hospitalized, but "remains strongly determined to devote himself to creative work through to the very end."
The announcement stated that Maeda has finished work for the first six chapters of the Heaven Burns Red game, including all the major story elements that will take the story to the end of the sixth chapter. He has also completed the lyrics and composition for the songs in the first half of the sixth chapter. Maeda may no longer be able to fulfill further writing and songwriting duties aside from the above mentioned segments dep Key writer/composer Jun Maeda announced he is in palliative care after a pharyngeal cancer diagnosis. publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Uma Musume: Pretty Derby – 7th Event World Tour: U.S. Concerts May Be Canceled The staff for Cygames' Uma Musume Pretty Derbyfranchise announced on Sunday that they have received notice that the U.S. visas needed for the upcoming Uma Musume: Pretty Derby – 7th Event World Tour: The Stage global tour, scheduled for October 22-23, have yet to be approved.
The staff stated they have been working with lawyers and promoters in the U.S. to secure the necessary visas for over six months. Staff added they are "coordinating with all parties concerned to explore every possible option to get the visas approved and make the concerts happen."
The staff will announce the final decision — whether it is possible to hold the concerts or not — by Monday, October 19 at 10:00 p.m. PDT (Tuesday, October 20 at 1:00 a.m. EDT).
The staff apologized for the concern and inconvenience, and for giving the announcement close to the event date.
The Uma Musume: Pretty Derby – 7th Event World Tour: The Stage concertis scheduled on October 22 at 8:00 p.m. PDT and October 23 at 7:00 p.m. PDT at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles.

publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Yona of the Dawn Anime Sequel A red-haired princess loses her family and her kingdom… Now she must rise and fight for her throne!
Princess Yona lives an ideal life as the only princess of her kingdom. Doted on by her father, the king, and protected by her faithful guard Hak, she cherishes the time spent with the man she loves, Su-won. But everything changes on her 16th birthday when tragedy strikes her family!
Yona reels from the shock of witnessing a loved one's murder and having to fight for her life. With Hak's help, she flees the palace and struggles to survive while evading her enemy's forces. But where will this displaced princess go when all the paths before her are uncertain?
Kusanagi — the creator of Mugen Spiral, Game X Rush, and NG Life — launched the Yona of the Dawn manga in Hakusensha's Hana to Yume magazine in 2009. The manga ended serialization on December 19. The manga had a four-chapter "gaiden" spinoff that ended in Hana to Yume on July 3. The manga's 48th and final compiled book volume shipped on Tuesday. Viz Media released the 46th volume on July 3.
The first Yona of the Dawn television anime by Pierrot premiered in 2014 and aired for 24 episodes. The manga also inspired three original anim Pierrot Films announced it will animate the planned sequel to the Yona of the Dawn television anime. The official X account confirmed Pierrot Films will handle animation

"Let go of me already, you fool!!"
The battered stray cat — which should never have been able to talk — suddenly speaks?!
The stray cat turns out to be Kayden, the strongest of the Awakened, transformed by mysterious means.
Unable to return to his human form, Kayden begins living with Jiwoo...

The anime adaptation of Yona of the Dawn by Studio Pierrot originally aired in 2014, running for 24 episodes. Over 11 years later, in December 2025, a sequel anime was confirmed for the series, though details were scarce at the time. Now, the anime’s official X (formerly Twitter) account has revealed a new update confirming that Pierrot Films, the newly established brand under Studio Pierrot, will be handling the animation production for the upcoming sequel.
Though relatively new, Pierrot Films has already established its reputation through its work on the Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War arc and the currently airing Black Clover Season 2.
Yona of the Dawn Sequel Confirms Animation by Pierrot Films

After a long wait, the sequel was announced following the conclusion of the Yona of the Dawn manga’s serialization last year. Night Tales Club Disney+ is bringing a new Japanese supernatural horror TV show to its platform. A new trailer for the show has revealed its official release window for next year.
Based on a short horror story collection by Sawamura, the Night Tales Club show follows a successful businessman, Zenichi Hojo, obsessed with the inexplicable, who turns his attention to solving life’s biggest mysteries, unleashing all manner of bizarre horrors. The six-part series will officially premiere on Disney+ in January 2027.
Check out the Night Tales Club trailer below:
What happens in the Night Tales Club trailer?
The trailer opens with an overview of a warehouse-like place as the lights go out across the city. Suddenly, a man is heard screaming, and audiences are offered a first look at Hojo. The trailer shifts to Hojo filming a video, where he conveys that he is offering a reward of 20 million yen in gold to anyone who can provide legitimate, proven evidence of these anomalies known as bugs.
However, there are three main conditions to claim the reward. First, the reports must be verified facts without any lies. Secondly, a real victim must be involved. Finally, the claim should come with unique physical eviden Disney+ released a trailer for the upcoming Japanese supernatural horror series Night Tales Club, confirming a January 2027 premiere window. publication_fingerprints.headline: Alien (new film)
publication_fingerprints.event_text: Alien (new film) News came earlier this month that Fox was moving forward with a new Alien movie, as one writer spilled the beans about his own involvement. What was unclear at the time, though, was what the next steps for the franchise might be. After the blockbuster success of Alien: Romulus, which became the second highest-grossing movie […] A new Alien movie is in early development, focusing on the android David from the prequel series rather than being a sequel to Alien: Romulus. The project is being written by Aaron Guzikowski, who previously worked with Ridley Scott on the HBO Max series Raised by Wolves. The film will tie into the 2010 prequel sequels Prometheus and Alien: Covenant, using David as the connective element. Michael Fassbender is not formally attached and no director has been announced, indicating the film is still in its early stages.

publication_fingerprints.event_text: The Rocketeer Disney looks like it’s about to lose the rights to one of its most beloved superhero films. The Rocketeer Trust has filed notice to reclaim The Rocketeer from Disney, according to Boardwalk Times. The trust, represented by Jennifer Bawcum, sister of the late Dave Stevens, creator of the character, is invoking a clause in federal […] The Rocketeer Trust has filed a notice to reclaim the rights to The Rocketeer from Disney, with termination set for June 12, 2028. The Rocketeer Trust, represented by creator Dave Stevens' sister, filed the termination notice on June 11, 2026 Disney will retain distribution rights to existing productions but cannot produce new sequels or reboots without a new agreement after June 12, 2028 Previous revival attempts, including a 2019 Disney Junior series and stalled live‑action projects, have failed to secure Disney’s continued control  June 12, 2028

The Morning After An Open Bar The Night Before At MCM London Comic Con
The Morning After An Open Bar The Night Before At MCM London Comic Con... from those who made it back at least
On the way to MCM London Comic Con with a heavy head… because last night ReedPOP had an "Industry Mixer" open bar at the Waterfront on the side of London ExCel. And British comic conventions haven't had an open bar for a long time, and the word started to spread amongst comic creators, retailers, publishers and the like, with representatives from DC, Image, Dark Horse, Forbidden Planet, Diamond UK making their way around the building, following the Thames towards the sound of clinking glasses. It's partially David Baillie's fault, who put the word out as he arrived to find himself the only comics person there, and also to be a bit for shouting out at the Diamond UK Retailer meeting held in the Capital Suites of the ExCel that there was an open bar… and here's the TikTok proof.

The romantic comedy centers on Riyo Washizu, the daughter of the leader of the yakuza organization that occupies the Kanto region of Japan. Gō Kiritani, a young subordinate in the organization, becomes Riyo's caretaker. He expects her to be just a docile child, but he soon learns that Riyo has a certain fetish — she loves seeing strong people when they are weak.
The manga debuted on Kodansha's Comic Days app in August 2024. Kodansha shipped the fifth volume on July 16.

Kadokawa World Manga English Label Launch News
Kadokawa Launches 'Kadokawa World Manga' English Label on its KadoComi Platform
posted on  by Crystalyn Hodgkins
Kadokawa announced on Friday it has launched the "Kadokawa World Manga" label dedicated to English releases of ongoing manga series on its web manga platform KadoComi. The label is available here.
The label offers the opening and latest chapters of selected series for free in English for international audiences. Kadokawa stated it will add more titles over time to expand the lineup. The company also stated the label is also a publishing platform for "Kadokawa World Manga Atelier," the publisher's initiative "dedicating to discovering and supporting international creators to develop original works."
The launch lineup for the new label includes:

The Green Sorceress uses strategies she learns from the unfolding events of WWII to snatch victory from the jaws of defeat in Simon & Kirby's Blue Bolt #7.
Article Summary
- Blue Bolt #7 channels the early WWII crisis into a Simon and Kirby sci-fi clash with striking Golden Age energy.
- The Green Sorceress studies dictatorship tactics on a telescreen and turns blitzkrieg, sabotage, and propaganda against Blue Bolt.
- The Blue Bolt saga in issue #7 captures Joe Simon and Jack Kirby hitting their stride on both story and wartime atmosphere.
- The issue also features wartime tales by Paul Gustavson and Andrew McWhiney, from stolen rail guns to Air Corps bombers.

In their story in Blue Bolt #7 (December 1940), the Green Sorceress appears to be defeated when she sees Europe's dictators on a telescreen while a captive of Blue Bolt. New promo video previews opening theme
Kadokawa presented the full promotional video for the television anime of Ayune Araragi's Isshiki-san Wants to Know About Love (Isshiki-san wa Koi o Shiritai) manga on Saturday. The video announces that Enako is both singing the anime's opening theme song "Gō Yoku Koi o Seisu!?" and joining the cast as the nurse Nene Haneshita.
The anime will debut in January 2027 and will air on AT-X, Kansai TV, and Tokyo MX. An advanced screening of the first two episodes will be held in Tokyo on December 13.
The romantic comedy follows Isshiki Rinna Milford, an elite, straight-laced officer who joined the police at age 17 (but has not experienced romantic love), and Meishi Rokutanda, a kind but scatterbrained and incompetent detective. Romelia War Chronicle Anime Seven Seaslicensed the novels' manga adaptation, and it describes the story:
After journeying alongside her fiancé on his quest to defeat the Demon King, Romelia is suddenly deemed useless and sent home, her engagement annulled. While the prince and his group return as celebrated heroes, Rome goes home as a disgrace. But she's not the same girl who left her province. While following the adventurers, Rome was the only one without magic or strength but she found her own abilities in trade, negotiation, finances, and gathering information. And now, she plans to use these skills to not only help her family's province, but help the still struggling kingdom. The Demon King may be defeated, but his allies and demons continue to roam.
With only her wits and brilliance, Rome will build an army of her own and keep the kingdom safe—no matter what it takes.

The debut of the Golden Age Daredevil in Silver Streak Comics #6 borrows elements from Batman stories in Detective Comics #38, #33 and #27.
Silver Streak Comics is a rarity among Golden Age titles in that it was launched with a villain as the cover feature. That villain, The Claw, was both an obvious example of war-era propaganda and based on a blatant racial stereotype. Publisher Lev Gleason was so intent on focusing on this wartime enemies theme that The Claw was cover-featured for the first two issues of the title, with the character meeting with Adolf Hitler in issue #2 and offering to team up with him to conquer the world and split it between them. The title's namesake, the dead-then-resurrected superhero flying speedster character Silver Streak, who himself was named after the futuristic race car in which he was killed, didn't show up until issue #3. publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Brought To Light: Shadowplay stage adaptation Posted in: Comics, Pop Culture | Tagged: Alan Moore, Bill Sienkiewicz, Brought To Light, canada, stage, theatre
Alan Moore & Bill Sienkiewicz's Brought To Light, On Stage, On Video
Alan Moore and Bill Sienkiewicz's Brought To Light theatrical adaptation has been uploaded to YouTube, twice
Article Summary
- Alan Moore and Bill Sienkiewicz's Brought To Light: Shadowplay has now reached the stage in an authorised Toronto adaptation.
- James Llewellyn Evans staged Shadowplay 1989 as a one-night performance in a basement goth bar, with handmade props and projections.
- Two YouTube uploads are now available: a close-up dress rehearsal cut and a static archival performance video with audience reaction.

publication_fingerprints.headline: Ben Wang in talks to play MCU’s Iceman
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Ben Wang in talks to play MCU’s Iceman Deadline reports Ben Wang (Karate Kid: Legends, American Born Chinese) is in talks to play Bobby Drake/Iceman in the MCU’s X-Men reboot. Wang, 29, purportedly beat out Gabriel LaBelle (The Fabelmans), Jackson Kelly (The Body), and Rhenzy Feliz (The Penguin) for the part of the X-Men’s frosty longtime member in the film, which is being directed by Jake Schreier (Thunderbolts*) for a release in 2028.
Wang, who is a Chinese-born American, would become the second actor to play Iceman on film, following Shawn Ashmore (who portrayed him in the 2000-06 trilogy, and 2014’s Days of Future Past), and the first Asian version of the character. At the time of writing, the only other person of color who’s been cast in the film is Maya Boyd, who will play Ororo Munroe/Storm.
Since Ashmore played the part, the character of Iceman was revealed to be gay in the comics. Whether this will be the case in the movie remains to be seen, but it would add some further diversity to its onscreen cast; however, it should be noted that Kit Connor and Inde Navarrete, who are respectively playing Scott Summers/Cyclops and Anna Marie/Rogue, are both bisexual.

X-Men (2028) Casting Updates X-Men is rounding up Charles Xavier’s students. While Cyclops, Jean, Angel, Storm, and Rogue have been cast, certain characters still have people in the running to play them. One such character is Iceman, aka Bobby Drake, one of the original members of the X-Men. Reportedly, Ben Wang is currently in talks to play the character.
As reported by Deadline, Gabriel LaBelle, Jackson Kelly, and Rhenzy Feliz have tested for the part as well, but Wang seems to be the most likely actor to play the role. Yet, what has caught fans off guard is Wang’s age. While there were some who weren’t so sure about his looks, his being 29 has given a few fans pause for thought. Many believe that while he might look younger than his age now, it may pose a problem later.
However, given that the actor has scores of projects like the upcoming The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping under his belt, he remains a strong pick for the character, age notwithstanding.

ThunderCats: Lynxana Dynamite has revealed blind bagged copies of the ThunderCats relaunch will include a new comic this week: ThunderCats: Lynxana, a one-shot by writer Nate Cosby (Cheetara: Worldbreaker) and artist Sebastián Píriz (Johnny Quest), starring Lynxana the bounty hunter. Lynxana never appeared on the original TV show, but was introduced in the fourth issue of the Marvel Comics series (created by David Michelinie, Jim Mooney, and Brett Breeding) in 1986.
Cosby outlined the premise, saying, “We snuck a western into the ThunderCats universe. A distress call gets sent out from a shady planet that’s home to the roughest bounty hunters in all the galaxy. Bluegrass (of SilverHawks) goes to answer the call, but gets shot down before he can even begin to investigate. What, and WHO, he finds on that planet, is gonna impact the ThunderCats comics franchise for years to come.”
The comic will set up a follow-up arriving in February 2027, that will in turn lead to Lynxana “crash[ing]” into the main series by Greg Pak and David Cousens, and the Cheetara comic by Saladin Ahmed and Andrea Arcari. Copies will feature further variations of the cover by Píriz, including printings in black-and-white, without t Dynamite will include the new one-shot ThunderCats: Lynxana in blind‑bag copies of its ThunderCats relaunch this week.
