Seven Seas Licenses Led by Stars Manga, Melting Point Manhwa, 3 Audiobooks
posted on  by Anita Tai
Seven Seas announced the following audiobook and manga licenses on Wednesday:
Title: 7th Time Loop: The Villainess Enjoys a Carefree Life Married to Her Worst Enemy! Short Story Collection  audiobook
Creators: Tōko Amekawa, Wan Hachipisu
Narration: Sarah Gage
Release Date: November 19 (Siren imprint)
Summary: This handpicked selection showcases dozens of delightful tales, including tender moments between Arnold and Rishe not depicted in the main story and glimpses of characters who aren't often in the limelight. See what Oliver, Arnold's stalwart attendant, gets up to during his time off—and what his relationship is like with his lord's little brother. Peer into a world where Arnold and Rishe are nothing more than students at the same academy. A few tales even feature Rishe's past lives from the perspectives of those she was close to. In the longest story, written specifically for this collection, Rishe and Arnold go undercover…as a married couple! Spirit Circle TV Anime Adaptation Satoshi Mizukami’s Spirit Circle manga is officially getting a TV anime adaptation, with the release date set for December 2026. A teaser visual and first promotional video were revealed alongside the announcement.
The anime will run for 18 episodes and follows Fuuta Okeya, a 14-year-old boy who can see ghosts, and transfer student Kouko Ishigami. After Kouko notices the strange mark hidden beneath the bandage on Fuuta’s cheek, she reveals that the two are connected through multiple past lives and begins targeting him over a grudge carried across reincarnations.
The announced cast includes:
- Kazuki Ura as Fuuta Okeya
- Anna Nagase as Kouko Ishigami
- Eri Yukimura as Rune
- Yuichi Nakamura as East
Anna Nagase also performs the ending theme, “Koko ga Donna Sekai demo,” marking her first solo vocal performance.
Tatsuo Sato serves as director and series composer, with Kentaro Mizuno as assistant director and Satoru Fujimoto handling character design. NAGOMI and EOTA are co-producing the animation, with TWIN ENGINE producing the series.
Sato, known for works including Martian Successor Nadesico, Bodacious Space Pirates, and Stellvia, passed away in April 2026. Trigun Manuscript Trigun is officially making another comeback this winter, and fans couldn't be happier to see their favorite anime Western return once more.
A new novel titled Trigun Manuscript was recently announced in the autumn issue of Sheisha's Jump SQ. Rise magazine, per ANN. Trigun Manuscript is co-written by original franchise creator Yasuhiro Nightow and Trigun Stampede scribe Takehiko Oxi, and will reportedly take place in the same timeline as Trigun Stampede and Trigun Stargaze.
Trigun Creator Yasuhiro Nightow Returns for New Release Set in the Stampede and Stargaze Timeline
Although no plot synopsis has been made available for Trigun Manuscript as of writing, the official Trigun anime social media accounts describe the upcoming title as "The long-awaited novelization." As such, fans are expecting that Trigun Manuscript will revisit many of the events of Trigun Stampede and Trigun Stargazer, albeit with new insight and potentially entirely new sequences that were absent from both its predecessors.
Produced by studio Orange, Trigun Stampeded premiered in 2023 as the second anime adaptation of Yasuhiro Nightow's original manga. Laid-Back Camp Season 4's Trailer Unveils April 2027 Debut
posted on  by Egan Loo
The official website for the television anime of Afro's Laid-Back Camp manga presented the main trailer and main visual for the anime's fourth season on Friday. The trailer and visual announce the season's April 2027 premiere , and the trailer also previews the theme songs.
The trailer features artist Asaka's opening theme song "Brand New.," artist Eri Sasaki's ending theme song "Happa no Tegami" (Leaf Letter), and the band Kiminone's overall series theme song "Tonari ni Ireba."
The website lists the following additional staff members:
- Cooking Design: Kōichi Motomura
- Prop Design: Masateru Inada
- Color Key Artist: Nanako Okazaki
- Art Director: Masatoshi Muto
- Background Art: Studio Jack
- Compositing Director of Photography: Yūta Katayama
- CG Director: Kazuto Furuya
- Offline Editing: Akinori Mishima (Mishima Editing Room)
- Music Produciton: MFIVE
- Sound Production: HALF H·P STUDIO
- Animation Producer: Sōta Machiguchi
The returning cast members include:
- Yumiri Hanamori as Nadeshiko Kagamihara

Sins of Kujo After a debut on Netflix, ABC’s hit crime drama is finally coming back. Season 5 of Will Trent will be premiering in a matter of months.
ABC has released its midseason 2027 schedule, and via The Hollywood Reporter, it reveals that Will Trent is set to return on Tuesday, Jan. 5. Will Trent has been on hiatus since May, and like The Rookie, has been airing exclusively during midseason for the last couple of years. That format is continuing for Season 5, but the wait will surely be worth it.
Will Trent Continues to Be a Hit for ABC
Premiering in 2023, Will Trent was created by Liz Heldens and Daniel Thomsen. It’s based on the series of novels by Karin Slaughter. Ramón Rodriguez stars as the titular Georgia Bureau of Investigation (GBI) Special Agent, who was abandoned at birth and “endured a harsh coming-of-age in Atlanta’s overwhelmed foster care system. Now, Will uses his unique point of view in the pursuit of justice and has the highest clearance rate in the GBI.”
Along with Rodriguez, Will Trent stars Erika Christensen, Iantha Richardson, Jake McLaughlin, Kevin Daniels, and Alexandra Metz. Season 4 saw the departure of series regular Sonja Sohn, whose character, GBI Deputy Directo Netflix Japan released the main trailer for the live‑action adaptation of Shohei Manabe’s legal drama manga Sins of Kujo, set to stream worldwide on April 2, 2026. The Rookie The Rookie may have been absent from the fall 2026 schedule, but the franchise is about to make a big comeback. The Mothership and its latest spinoff are officially returning to ABC in three months.
According to The Hollywood Reporter, the Disney-owned network has confirmed that both The Rookie and The Rookie: North will premiere on Wednesday, Jan. 6. The Rookie's return date was previously announced at New York Comic Con, along with the spinoff, but ABC has now unveiled its full midseason schedule.
The Rookie Season 9 will kick off the two-hour block at 8 p.m. ET, followed by The Rookie: North at 10 p.m. ET. Shifting Gears will join the procedurals for Season 3 on Jan. 6, with Abbott Elementary rejoining the lineup the following week to continue Season 6.
What Happened in The Rookie Season 8?
When The Rookie premieres its ninth season in January, the series will be picking up from a major cliffhanger. The end of the Season 8 finale in May saw fan-favorite couple Tim Bradford (Eric Winter) and Lucy Chen (Melissa O’Neil) finally getting engaged. Abema Selects Project PRISMation's 1st Open Call Finalists to Make 3 Pilot Anime
posted on  by Egan Loo

The three selected entries are:
"OXY-HEAVEN"

A fantasy ensemble drama set in a steampunk world.

Gacha Girls Corps Gacha Girls Corps anime announced a January 7, 2027 premiere date. A main visual and two additional cast members were also released. Joining the cast are Aimi Ozawa as Migle and Renon Esumi as Lennon.
A trailer was previously released. Takashi Asami is directing the anime at studios Zero-G and Saber Works. Deko Akao is in charge of series composition, while Minewo Suzuki is in charge of character designs. Hiroaki Tsutsumi and George King are composing the music. The cast includes:
- Daisuke Sakaguchi as Heihachi Okura
- Miyu Tomita as Norl Fanya
- Iori Noguchi as Estelle
Gacha Girls Corps is a light novel series written by Chinkururi with illustrations provided by Yasutaka Isekawa. It was originally launched as a web novel on the Shosetsuka ni Naro website in January 2016. Micro Magazine then published nine volumes in print under their GC Novels imprint from November 2016 to August 2020.
Syuu Haruno illustrated the manga adaptation, which began its serialization in Micro Magazine’s Comic Ride online magazine in March 2018. Kaiten Books is licensing the manga in English and they describe it as:

Takuma Nagatsuka as Yuki Inubo, a man who wants cure his blue mood
Nobuhiko Okamoto as Hitoshi Haritsukekawara; the twin-tailed, 50-year-old, decora-fashionista store manager
Showtaro Morikubo as Shō Dogenzaka, a flashy men who is 2 trillion yen (about US$12.6 billion) in debt

publication_fingerprints.event_text: Watchmen (HBO series) Image Courtesy of HBO It has been seven years since an HBO series helped fix the biggest problem with a Zack Snyder blockbuster comic book adaptation. In 2009, Snyder directed the DC big-screen adaptation of the Alan Moore and Dave Gibbons comic book Watchmen. The movie only had Gibbons’ name listed as the creator, and that is because Moore […] The HBO Watchmen series serves as a sequel to the original comics, addressing themes the 2009 film missed. The nine‑episode series continues the story years after the original Watchmen comics Created by Damon Lindelof as a direct sequel to Alan Moore and Dave Gibbons’ work, not the Zack Snyder film It re‑examines the fake alien attack, Dr. Manhattan’s imprisonment of Ozymandias, and Rorschach’s legacy HBO Max N/A
